notes: Nova Work introduces real desktop project workspaces backed by folders you explicitly choose
Work chats are isolated from regular chat history and stay attached to their own project
Nova builds a fast local file index and injects request-relevant source context into the selected AI provider
Workspace access is read-only with traversal protection, size limits, secret-file exclusions, and ignored dependency/build folders
Each workspace shows its local path, file count, chat history, and a one-click index refresh
The web app explains why folder-powered Work requires the desktop security boundary
